hero.title: Literary Renaissance: The Gupta Age
hero.description: An exploration of the Sanskrit literary zenith, marking the classical period of Indian intellectual and artistic expression.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: The era witnessed a transition from Prakrit to Sanskrit as the language of the elite.

cards.details: Emergence of court literature under Chandragupta I and Samudragupta.
Reign of Chandragupta II; Kalidasa's masterpieces redefine Sanskrit kavya.
Codification of Puranas and consolidation of scientific literature.

items.title: K.A.V.I.S (Kalidasa's Works)
items.decryption: Use this to recall the 2 epics, 3 plays, and 2 lyrical poems (Khandakavya).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Assuming all Gupta literature was religious; many works were secular (court poetry, science).
Confusing the language of the masses (Prakrit) with the language of the court (Sanskrit).

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Features

  • Sanskrit as Lingua Franca
  • Secular & Religious integration
  • Patronage by Royal Courts

Luminaries

  • Kalidasa: The Shakespeare of India
  • Vishakhadatta: Political dramatist
  • Sudraka: Social realism
  • Dramatic Literature:
    • Kalidasa: Abhijnanashakuntalam
    • Sudraka: Mrichhakatikam (Social drama about a merchant)
    • Vishakhadatta: Mudrarakshasa (Political intrigue of Chandragupta Maurya)
  • Epics & Puranas:
    • Final compilation of Puranas, Mahabharata, and Ramayana in their present form.
  • Scientific Literature:
    • Aryabhata: Aryabhatiya (Mathematics & Astronomy)
    • Varahamihira: Brihat Samhita
